blocks.text: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump’s administration marked Halloween on Saturday with violent videos celebrating its detention of migrants and the killing of foreign “enemies” by the US military. US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agency, which has led a mass deportation drive against undocumented migrants, posted a one-minute video on X to the tune of Michael Jackson’s hit song “Thriller.” It starts with a sequence of horror movie icons before shifting to images of arrests and migrants in detention, with captions such as “this guy was wanted for homicide.” READ: “Haunting the enemies of America,” announced the Defense Department on X […]...
